book.name: Umarku
book.title: Isarhe iyiki Ize iyi Umarku aka atsɛng

content: Uner ushai ubok ru Ukafarnahum
Ivang iyɔɔ unga aka atsĩ ru abã ifɛn-Num, uner uwɔɔ umɔ nggu uboknga ushushai.
Abɔɔ abee ubinkpi umbɔ aka ikũ akpo uvau ru Uyesu. Umbɔ atsu asumbɔ nu unga use unga awuri ikikerhuka utsak ha ru unum ukpuku uwosha.
Uyesu agɔr uner uwuku ushai ubok ha agɛ, <<Udzek udɛ̃ɛ̃ ra asumbɔ kishoo.>>
Uyesu arhusa umbɔ agɛ, <<Imɛ̃ɛ̃ umbɔ akorhu use ru unum ukpuku uwosha, akorhi iyiki ize use akorhi iyiki ibewe, afɔrhe urhɛ use afɛre umgbɔ?>> Bɔr umbɔ asei ukutata.
Unga arhi adziira umbɔ ra avɔm, amɛnnga adake ra amɛn aka akermbɔ, unga agɔr uner ushai ubok ha agɛ, <<Unamu ubokngo.>> Unga anamu uboknga udzek, Kanying ukpɔ ukerhukpɔ.
Mɔcɛ abi Ufarisi adzek akɛki itsũwã nggu aner Uhiridu, abee udĩ ukpuku ufɛr Uyesu.
Ikikɔng idɔsu Uyesu
Uyesu adzek nggu angwɛ̃ imesanga azĩmbɔ ubang ukau, arhɛrha anera adzeku Ugarhirhi adɔsa unga.
Umbɔ aka agũ abinkɛ unga aka akorhe kishoo, anera arhɛrhɛ aka adzeku Uyahudiya aba ru unga, nu Urusharhima, nu Uidumiya, nu abi ugar Azɛ̃ Urdun, nu aner Utaya nu Usidon.
Anera aka arhɛmbɔ, unga agɔr angwɛ̃ imesanga akpowe ukhukhɔɔ amɛ̃ uwuku uci adzowe unga, utsur anera afĩĩmbɔ unga.
Unga akerhuka anera arhɛrhɛ, nggee abi irhãrhã abee izĩ ra asu abanga unga.
Ivangyɛ ípfu iyiki ibewe iki inyã unga, ngge igba nú abĩ ra anangnga ni itsui ivum igɛ, <<Ungo uwu Ungwɛ̃ Unum!>>
Bɔr unga avange ngge niba idɛyikungge unera unerwi unga aka awe.
Isɛng abi itser Uyesu usɔkdũmɛn
Uyesu afũã igũ na ayisa abirabɛ unga aka abee, umbɔ aba ru unga.
Unga asɛng usɔkdũmɛn umbɔ aka iwe abi itser Uyesu ugɛ umbɔ awe nggu unga, nú unga adene umbɔ adzek adzise isarhe.
Umbɔ awuri iyiyɛimbɔ ijee iyiki itsusuwe ípfu iyiki ibewe.
Umbɔ hã abɛ, usɔkdũmɛn hã unga aka asɛng, Usiman, uwu ha Uyesu aki iyisa Ubitru,
nu Uyaku ungwɛ̃ Uzabadi nu ungwɛ̃mbɔ Uyohana, abirabɛ Uyesu iki iyisa ugɛ Ubuwarnaji, agbena agburh <<Angwɛ̃ Igbigbashu Inai,>>
nu Uandarawu, nu Ufirhibu, nu Ubatorhomi, nu Umatiyu, nu Utoma, nu Uyaku ungwɛ̃ Uharhfa, nu Utaddiyu, nu Usiman uner Ukan'ana,
nu Uyahuda Uiskariyoti uwuku ugha adaknga.
Uyesu nu Uba'arhzaburh
Mɔcɛ Uyesu abvui atsĩ ri iya. Anera abvui akɔng ikɛi, utsɛku unga nu angwɛ̃ imesanga asi idɛ̃ɛ̃ aghambɔ ubingha.
Abi iyambɔ aka agũ rimi, asok azĩmbɔ idzur unga. Anera anu igɔr agɛ, <<Unga aka azhɔmu ukpong!>>
Abika amesuwe Ikpem igambɔ adzeku Urusharhima aba agɔr agɛ, <<Awu Uba'arhzaburh uyɛrhe ípfu iyiki ibewe unga atsĩ ru unga! Akũ ijeenga ikɛi atsusuwe ipfu iyiki ibewe idzek.>>
Nggee Uyesu ayisa umbɔ na arherhuwe umbɔ unyaka arherhe agɛ, <<Ushaitan awuri ikorha aguse na awayiwe Ushaitan?
Iyɛrhe iba igaungge itsingge, iyɛrha ha isi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ngge.
Iya iba igauke itsike, iya ha isi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ke.
Rimi Ushaitan aba ugapa itsinga, unga asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃nga, imimashanga iki ibangge.
Idzidzɛrhe, unera asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ atsĩã ri iya uner uwuku uker akarhuka abinnga, awuri itirhi abow uner uwuku uker ha. Mɔcɛ unga awuri idɛ̃ɛ̃ avura abin iya ha.
Umum idɛyiwa umbi idzidzɛrhe, kishoo arhim nu irhenu Unum anera aki ikorhe, awuri itsitsũwũkumbɔ ake.
Bɔr ubɛn uwuku urhenu Ipfu Isarsatangge asi ítsũwũkumbɔ unga, awu ra arhim aki ugbagbaa.>>
Unga arherhe rimi, ubinkutsu umbɔ aka agɔr agɛ, <<Unga awe ru ipfu iyiki ibewe.>>
Uya Uyesu nu angwɛ̃mbɔ
Mɔcɛ uya Uyesu nggu angwɛ̃mbɔ aba atsĩ. Adɛ̃ɛ̃ nú awiya, na adene uwɔɔ unga ayisuwe Uyesu.
Ikikɔnga isei adziira unga, umbɔ adɛyiwe unga agɛ, <<Uyango nu anapumbi abeea ungo ra awiya.>>
Unga arhusa umbɔ agɛ, <<Awu umbɔ ungamɔ awu uyamum nu angwɛ̃mɛn?>>
Unga arhi abirabɛ aka asei adziira unga na agɛ, <<uyamum uwi nggu angwɛ̃mɛn!
Ubɛn unera aka ikorhu ubinkpi Unum aka abema, unga awu ungwɛ̃mɛn nu unapumɛn nu uyamum.>>
